schema_change_table.v2_0_behavior: All descriptors represent completed rendered packages.
schema_change_table.v2_1_behavior: Every descriptor declares one of four ordered lifecycle states.
schema_change_table.causal_reason: Pre-render packages need a truthful contract state.
schema_change_table.migration: Normalize v2.0 accepted artifacts to human_accepted and other rendered canaries to rendered.
schema_change_table.rollback: Remove v2.1 artifacts and continue validating unchanged v2.0 descriptors.

schema_change_table.v2_1_behavior: generated_project is absent before rendered and required from rendered onward.
schema_change_table.causal_reason: A package must validate before project generation.
schema_change_table.migration: Existing v2.0 project identities are retained by the compatibility normalizer.
schema_change_table.rollback: Use v2.0 only for completed rendered packages.

schema_change_table.v2_0_behavior: A passed technical receipt and MP4 identity are always required.
schema_change_table.v2_1_behavior: Render evidence is absent before rendered and required from rendered onward.
schema_change_table.causal_reason: Contract development must not force YMM4 or rendering.
schema_change_table.migration: Existing v2.0 render receipts remain exact and normalize to rendered evidence.

schema_change_table.v2_0_behavior: Root human_decision is always present, including not_human_accepted placeholders.
schema_change_table.v2_1_behavior: human_decision is absent until human_accepted and then requires an exact receipt.
schema_change_table.causal_reason: Absence must not be represented as fabricated decision evidence.
schema_change_table.migration: v2.0 not_human_accepted normalizes to rendered without human evidence.

schema_change_table.v2_0_behavior: Observed fixtures happened to use two speakers and mostly one asset per cue.
schema_change_table.v2_1_behavior: speaker_counts needs one or more positive entries; asset_count may be lower than cue_count when every cue has a provenance-bound view.
schema_change_table.causal_reason: Observed fixture shape is not a universal requirement.
schema_change_table.migration: No v2.0 rewrite; existing shapes remain valid through normalization.

schema_change_table.v2_0_behavior: Rights, production, publication, upload, and release are separate booleans with exact records when true.
schema_change_table.v2_1_behavior: The same clocks remain separate and are never implied by lifecycle.
schema_change_table.causal_reason: Technical maturity cannot grant creative, legal, production, or public authority.
schema_change_table.migration: Copy clock state read-only during normalization.
schema_change_table.rollback: Unchanged v2.0 authority clocks remain authoritative.

delta_rows.validation_rule: must be one ordered lifecycle state
must be true only after all state-specific validation passes
false at package_prepared and true from source_project_ready onward
false before rendered and true from rendered onward
true only at human_accepted with exact receipt
null when planned; repository-relative path when ready
null when planned; exact SHA-256 when ready
absent before rendered; required from rendered onward
absent before rendered; passed exact evidence required from rendered onward
absent before human_accepted; exact accepted record required at human_accepted
planned_not_observed at package_prepared; observed basis at later states
four normalized values within image bounds
safe run ID excluded from content identity

delta_rows.consumer: rights, production, publication, upload, and release owners
delta_rows.validation_rule: lifecycle never changes the clock; true requires exact record
